{{ _("I, being of full legal capacity, acknowledge the following:", context=C) }}

  1. {{ _("I acknowledge that I am still in service with", context=C) }} {{ _("Abdullah Fahad Al-Mutairi Support Services Company", context=C) }}{{ _(", and that I enjoy all the employment rights set out in the Saudi Labor Law and the approved Work Regulations of the company.", context=C) }}
  2. {{ _("At my personal request and wish, my annual leave pay for the current year", context=C) }} {{ _("2025 AD", context=C) }} {{ _("has been paid in advance to ease my personal financial circumstances, without affecting my full right to take my statutory annual leave.", context=C) }}
  3. {{ _("I acknowledge that my annual leave starts on ___ / ___ / 2025 AD for ____________ days, and I commit to actually taking the leave according to the schedule approved by the company management.", context=C) }}
  4. {{ _("I state that the amount paid to me is my annual leave pay in advance, under Article (109) of the Labor Law, and is in no case a compensation in lieu of the leave or a waiver of it.", context=C) }}
  5. {{ _("I undertake not to work in any form during the leave (full time, part time or additional assignments), and I understand that any work during the leave requires prior written approval of the company management only, without any additional financial obligation unless agreed in writing.", context=C) }}
  6. {{ _("I acknowledge that the advance payment of leave pay gives me no additional right to claim other amounts for the leave, and I undertake not to submit additional financial claims as work allowance or leave compensation as long as I take my leave on its set date.", context=C) }}
  7. {{ _("I bear full legal and administrative responsibility for the accuracy of this undertaking, and I agree to its keeping in my employment file at the company for reliance when needed.", context=C) }}
